description: This file defines classes, structs, constants, and functions related to the RPC (Remote Procedure Call) agent in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework. It includes declarations for RpcAgent, WorkerInfo, RpcRetryOptions, and related utilities, as well as external file references and method signatures used for distributed communication.

classes.name: WorkerInfo
classes.description: Represents a globally unique identifier for an RPC worker, including name and ID.

classes.name: RpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for RPC backend, such as timeout and init method.

classes.name: RegisterWorkerInfoOnce
classes.description: Ensures registration of worker info occurs only once.

classes.name: RpcRetryOptions
classes.description: Configures retry behavior for RPC calls, including max retries, retry duration, and backoff factor.

classes.name: RpcRetryInfo
classes.description: Stores metadata for retrying a specific RPC, including target worker, message, future, retry count, and options.

classes.name: RpcAgent
classes.description: Base class for sending and receiving RPC messages, managing retries, and handling distributed RPC communication.

methods.name: WorkerInfo(std::string, int64_t)
methods.description: Constructor for WorkerInfo with name and ID.

methods.name: WorkerInfo(std::string, worker_id_t)
methods.description: Constructor for WorkerInfo with name and worker ID.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs WorkerInfo to an ostream.

methods.name: RpcAgent
methods.description: Constructor for RpcAgent, initializing with worker info, callback, and timeout.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message to a target worker.

methods.name: sendWithRetries
methods.description: Sends a message with retry logic based on RpcRetryOptions.

methods.name: getWorkerInfo
methods.description: Returns WorkerInfo of this RpcAgent.

methods.name: getWorkerInfo
methods.description: Returns WorkerInfo of a worker by name.

methods.name: getWorkerInfo
methods.description: Returns WorkerInfo of a worker by ID.

methods.name: getWorkerInfos
methods.description: Returns list of all WorkerInfos.

methods.name: getRpcTimeout
methods.description: Returns current RPC timeout duration.

methods.name: setRpcTimeout
methods.description: Sets the RPC timeout duration.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins internal threads and optionally shuts down.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes with other RpcAgents, sending pending messages.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the RPC agent, setting up background threads.

methods.name: startImpl
methods.description: Backend-specific initialization for starting the RPC agent.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the RPC agent and background threads.

methods.name: shutdownImpl
methods.description: Backend-specific cleanup for shutdown.

methods.name: isGILProfilingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GIL profiling is enabled.

methods.name: enableGILProfiling
methods.description: Enables or disables GIL wait time profiling.

methods.name: setTypeResolver
methods.description: Sets the type resolver for JIT type resolution.

methods.name: getTypeResolver
methods.description: Gets the current type resolver.

methods.name: getDeviceMap
methods.description: Retrieves device mapping for a destination worker.

methods.name: getDevices
methods.description: Returns supported devices by the agent.

methods.name: addGilWaitTime
methods.description: Records GIL wait time for profiling.

methods.name: retryExpiredRpcs
methods.description: Background thread function to retry expired RPCs.

methods.name: rpcRetryCallback
methods.description: Callback for handling RPC retry logic.

methods.name: computeNewRpcRetryTime
methods.description: Calculates next retry time using exponential backoff.
